speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have multiple skin lesions; can you tell me how long they have been present and if they are changing in size or color?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum. The clinical presentation of painless, non-pruritic papules in a daycare setting with a history of close contact is classic for this viral infection. The recent chickenpox in the brother and up-to-date immunizations make varicella unlikely. No further testing or imaging is required at this time.
